title: Large Stone Bricks
description: Large Stone Bricks mod I made for Beta 1.7.3
body: This mod is for Beta 1.7.3, and it adds Large Stone Bricks. They’re bigger and rougher than the normal stone bricks, and work very well for castles, ruins, forts, towers, and underground halls. I wanted something that looked more old and heavy, so I made these. They fit nicely with cobblestone and mossy cobblestone, and make large walls look less flat and repetitive. Requires Risugami’s ModLoader to work properly.
